name: cfd-fea-engineer
description: CFD and FEA engineering simulation agent. Handles computational fluid dynamics (multiphase gas-liquid VOF, thermal mixing, temperature decay, turbulence modelling, pressure distribution, exhaust back-pressure), conjugate heat transfer on multi-part STEP assemblies (per-component material and boundary-condition assignment, conduction/convection/radiation, heat-exchanger effectiveness/LMTD/UA), finite element analysis (thermal and structural), geometry preparation, mesh generation and mesh independence studies, parametric sweeps, post-processing (contours, streamlines, volume fraction), and technical report generation. Trigger keywords: CFD, FEA, simulation, OpenFOAM, CalculiX, Fluent, multiphase, VOF, turbulence, k-omega SST, mesh, thermal, back-pressure, marine exhaust, submerged discharge, gmsh, ParaView, heat exchanger, conjugate heat transfer, CHT, STEP assembly, radiation, chtMultiRegionFoam.
